docs.title: Overview
docs.text: This script uses the pyvisa library to communicate with external hardware over VISA protocol (e.g., GPIB, USB, RS232). It’s used to query device identity and test connectivity.

docs.title: This script sets up a Data Acquisition (DAQ) task using NI-DAQmx in
It defines which channels to use, the timing of the acquisition,
and how the DAQ system starts and stops.
docs.text:
Setup Import the NI-DAQmx Python library.

python Copy Edit import nidaqmx Create a new task object to manage all DAQ operations.

python Copy Edit task = nidaqmx.Task() Channel Configuration Add AI0 channel on device Dev1 with ±10V input range.

python Copy Edit task.ai_channels.add_ai_voltage_chan("Dev1/ai0", min_val=-10.0, max_val=10.0) Clock and Sampling Rate Configure the sample clock for 1000 samples per second, continuous mode.

python Copy Edit task.timing.cfg_samp_clk_timing( rate=1000, sample_mode=nidaqmx.constants.AcquisitionType.CONTINUOUS ) Task Execution Start the task to begin acquisition.

python Copy Edit task.start() Insert acquisition logic here, e.g., read buffer or log data.

python Copy Edit
